const.mapping: original UTF-16 coordinates through validated editorial edits; reject mixed-boundary edits and typography drift
const.scope: Reading paragraph text only; omit whole-paragraph decoration independently per property
const.source: direct DOCX run properties at the exact paragraph locator; no inferred or inherited styling

grid.const: columnStart and columnSpan cover every row exactly once after active rowSpan occupancy

mediaRef.const: mediaId resolves within the same canonical question group; alt is required literal text

rowSpan.const: integer >= 1; reserves every covered column in following rows and may not exceed the final row
